title: अंश ६ · अध्याय १

items.speaker: मैत्रेय उवाच
items.text:
व्याख्याता भवता सर्ग-वंश-मन्वन्तरस्थितः ।
वंशानुचरितञ्चवै विस्तरेण महामुने ॥ १ ॥
items.tr:
vyākhyātā bhavatā sarga-vaṃśa-manvantarasthitaḥ |
vaṃśānucaritañcavai vistareṇa mahāmune || 1 ||

items.text:
श्रोतुमिच्छाम्यहं त्वत्तो यथावदूपसंह्टतिम् ।
महाप्रलयसंस्थानं कल्पान्ते च महामुने ॥ २ ॥
items.tr:
śrotumicchāmyahaṃ tvatto yathāvadūpasaṃhṭatim |
mahāpralayasaṃsthānaṃ kalpānte ca mahāmune || 2 ||

items.speaker: पराशा उवाच
items.text:
मैत्रेय श्रुयतां मत्तो यथावदुपसंह्टतिः ।
कल्पान्ते प्राकृते चैव प्रलयो जायते यथा ॥ ३ ॥
items.tr:
maitreya śruyatāṃ matto yathāvadupasaṃhṭatiḥ |
kalpānte prākṛte caiva pralayo jāyate yathā || 3 ||

items.text:
अहोरात्रं पितणान्तु मासोऽब्दस्त्रिदिवौकसाम
चतुर्युगसहस्त्र तु ब्रह्मणो द्रे द्रिजोत्तम ॥ ४ ॥
items.tr:
ahorātraṃ pitaṇāntu māso'bdastridivaukasāma
caturyugasahastra tu brahmaṇo dre drijottama || 4 ||

items.text:
कृतं त्रेता द्रापरश्व कलिश्चैव चतुर्युगम् ।
दिव्यैर्वर्षसहस्त्रैस्तु तदू द्रादशभिरुच्यते ॥ ५ ॥
items.tr:
kṛtaṃ tretā drāparaśva kaliścaiva caturyugam |
divyairvarṣasahastraistu tadū drādaśabhirucyate || 5 ||

items.text:
चतुर्युगाण्यशेषाणि सदृशानि स्वरूपतः ।
आद्य कृतयुगं मुक्त्वा मैत्रेयान्ते तथा कलिम् ॥ ६ ॥
items.tr:
caturyugāṇyaśeṣāṇi sadṛśāni svarūpataḥ |
ādya kṛtayugaṃ muktvā maitreyānte tathā kalim || 6 ||

items.text:
आद्ये कृतयुगो सर्गा ब्रह्मणा क्रियते यतः
क्रियते चोपसंहारस्तथान्ते च कलौ युगे ॥ ७ ॥
items.tr:
ādye kṛtayugo sargā brahmaṇā kriyate yataḥ
kriyate copasaṃhārastathānte ca kalau yuge || 7 ||

items.speaker: मैत्रेय उवाच
items.text:
कलेः स्वरूपं भगवन् विस्तरादू वक्तुमर्हसि ।
धर्म्मश्वतुष्पाद्भगवन यस्मिन विप्लवमृच्छति ॥ ८ ॥
items.tr:
kaleḥ svarūpaṃ bhagavan vistarādū vaktumarhasi |
dharmmaśvatuṣpādbhagavana yasmina viplavamṛcchati || 8 ||

items.speaker: पराशर उवाच
items.text:
कलेः खरूपं मैत्रेय यद्भवान् प्रष्टुमिच्छति ।
तन्निबोध समासन्नं वर्त्तते यन्महामुने ॥ ९ ॥
items.tr:
kaleḥ kharūpaṃ maitreya yadbhavān praṣṭumicchati |
tannibodha samāsannaṃ varttate yanmahāmune || 9 ||

items.text:
वर्णाश्रमाचारवती प्रवृत्तिर्न कलौ नृणाम् ।
नसाम-ऋगू-यजुर्व्वेदविनिष्पादनहेतुका ॥ १० ॥
items.tr:
varṇāśramācāravatī pravṛttirna kalau nṛṇām |
nasāma-ṛgū-yajurvvedaviniṣpādanahetukā || 10 ||

items.text:
विवाहा न कलौ धर्म्म्या न शिष्य-गुरुसंस्थितिः ।
नि दाम्पत्यक्रमो नैव वह्निदैवात्मकः क्रमः ॥ ११ ॥
items.tr:
vivāhā na kalau dharmmyā na śiṣya-gurusaṃsthitiḥ |
ni dāmpatyakramo naiva vahnidaivātmakaḥ kramaḥ || 11 ||

items.text:
यत्र तत्र कुले जातो बली सर्व्वेस्वरः कलौ ।
सर्व्वेभ्य एव वर्णेभ्यो योग्यः कन्यावरोधने ॥ १२ ॥
items.tr:
yatra tatra kule jāto balī sarvvesvaraḥ kalau |
sarvvebhya eva varṇebhyo yogyaḥ kanyāvarodhane || 12 ||

items.text:
येन कैनैव योगेन द्रिजातिर्दीक्षितः कलौ ।
यौव सैव च मैत्रेय प्रायश्वित्तक्रिया कलौ ॥ १३ ॥
items.tr:
yena kainaiva yogena drijātirdīkṣitaḥ kalau |
yauva saiva ca maitreya prāyaśvittakriyā kalau || 13 ||

items.text:
सर्व्वमेव कलौ शास्त्रं यस्य यदूवचनं द्रिज ।
देवाताश्व कलौ सर्व्वाः सर्व्वः सर्व्वस्य चाश्रमः ॥ १४ ॥
items.tr:
sarvvameva kalau śāstraṃ yasya yadūvacanaṃ drija |
devātāśva kalau sarvvāḥ sarvvaḥ sarvvasya cāśramaḥ || 14 ||

items.text:
उपवासस्तथायासो वित्तोतूसर्गस्तथा कलौ ।
धर्म्मो यथाभिरुचितैरनुष्ठानैरनुष्ठितः ॥ १५ ॥
items.tr:
upavāsastathāyāso vittotūsargastathā kalau |
dharmmo yathābhirucitairanuṣṭhānairanuṣṭhitaḥ || 15 ||

items.text:
वित्तेन भविता पुंसां स्वल्पेनाढ्यमदः कलौ ।
स्त्रीणां रूपमदश्चैव केशैरेव भविष्यति ॥ १६ ॥
items.tr:
vittena bhavitā puṃsāṃ svalpenāḍhyamadaḥ kalau |
strīṇāṃ rūpamadaścaiva keśaireva bhaviṣyati || 16 ||

items.text:
सुवर्णमणिरत्रादौ वस्त्रे चापि क्षयं गते ।
कलौ स्त्रियो भविष्यन्ति तदा केशैरलङ्कृताः ॥ १७ ॥
items.tr:
suvarṇamaṇiratrādau vastre cāpi kṣayaṃ gate |
kalau striyo bhaviṣyanti tadā keśairalaṅkṛtāḥ || 17 ||

items.text:
परित्यक्षन्ति भर्त्तारं वित्तहीनं तथा स्त्रियः ।
भर्त्ता भविष्यति कलौ वित्तवानेव योषिताम् ॥ १८ ॥
items.tr:
parityakṣanti bharttāraṃ vittahīnaṃ tathā striyaḥ |
bharttā bhaviṣyati kalau vittavāneva yoṣitām || 18 ||

items.text:
योयो ददाति बहुल सस स्वामी तदा नृणाम् ।
स्वामित्वहेतुः सम्बन्ध भावी नाभिजनस्तदा ॥ १९ ॥
items.tr:
yoyo dadāti bahula sasa svāmī tadā nṛṇām |
svāmitvahetuḥ sambandha bhāvī nābhijanastadā || 19 ||

items.text:
गृहान्ता द्रव्यसङ्घाता द्रव्यान्ता च तथा मतिः ।
अर्थाश्वात्मोपभोगान्ता भविष्यन्ति कलौ युगे ॥ २० ॥
items.tr:
gṛhāntā dravyasaṅghātā dravyāntā ca tathā matiḥ |
arthāśvātmopabhogāntā bhaviṣyanti kalau yuge || 20 ||

items.text:
स्त्रियः कलौ भविष्यन्ति स्वैरिणयो ललितस्पृहाः ।
अन्यायावाप्तवित्तेषु पुरुषाश्व स्पृहालवः ॥ २१ ॥
items.tr:
striyaḥ kalau bhaviṣyanti svairiṇayo lalitaspṛhāḥ |
anyāyāvāptavitteṣu puruṣāśva spṛhālavaḥ || 21 ||

items.text:
अभ्यर्थितोऽपि सुह्टदा स्वार्थहानिं न मानवः ।
पणार्द्धार्द्धार्द्धमात्रेऽपि करिष्यति तदा द्रिज ॥ २२ ॥
items.tr:
abhyarthito'pi suhṭadā svārthahāniṃ na mānavaḥ |
paṇārddhārddhārddhamātre'pi kariṣyati tadā drija || 22 ||

items.text:
समानं पौरुषञ्चतो भावि विप्र षु वै कलौ ।
क्षीरप्रदानसम्बन्धि भावि गोषु च गौरवम् ॥ २३ ॥
items.tr:
samānaṃ pauruṣañcato bhāvi vipra ṣu vai kalau |
kṣīrapradānasambandhi bhāvi goṣu ca gauravam || 23 ||

items.text:
अनावृष्टिभियप्रायाः प्रजाः क्षुद्भयकातराः ।
भविष्यन्ति तदा सर्व्वा गगनासक्तदृष्टयः ॥ २४ ॥
items.tr:
anāvṛṣṭibhiyaprāyāḥ prajāḥ kṣudbhayakātarāḥ |
bhaviṣyanti tadā sarvvā gaganāsaktadṛṣṭayaḥ || 24 ||

items.text:
कन्दपर्णफलाहारास्तापसा इव मानवाः ।
आत्मानं पातयिष्यन्ति तदा वृष्ट्यादिदुः खिताः ॥ २५ ॥
items.tr:
kandaparṇaphalāhārāstāpasā iva mānavāḥ |
ātmānaṃ pātayiṣyanti tadā vṛṣṭyādiduḥ khitāḥ || 25 ||

items.text:
दुर्भिक्षमेव सततं तदा क्ले शमनीश्वराः ।
प्रापूस्यन्ति व्याहतसुखप्रमोदा मानवाः कलौ ॥ २६ ॥
items.tr:
durbhikṣameva satataṃ tadā kle śamanīśvarāḥ |
prāpūsyanti vyāhatasukhapramodā mānavāḥ kalau || 26 ||

items.text:
अस्त्रानबोजिनो नाग्रिदेवतातिथिपूजनूम् ।
करिष्यन्ति कलौ प्राप्ते न च पिव्योदकक्रियाम् ॥ २७ ॥
items.tr:
astrānabojino nāgridevatātithipūjanūm |
kariṣyanti kalau prāpte na ca pivyodakakriyām || 27 ||

items.text:
लोलुपा ह्रस्वदेहाश्व वह्वन्नादनतत्पराः ।
बहुप्रजाल्पभाग्याश्व भविष्यन्ति कलौ स्त्रियः ॥ २८ ॥
items.tr:
lolupā hrasvadehāśva vahvannādanatatparāḥ |
bahuprajālpabhāgyāśva bhaviṣyanti kalau striyaḥ || 28 ||

items.text:
उभाभ्यामेव पाणिभ्यां शिरः कण्डूयनं स्त्रियः ।
कुर्व्वन्त्यो गुरुभर्त्तृणामाज्ञां भेतूस्यन्त्यनादृताः ॥ २९ ॥
items.tr:
ubhābhyāmeva pāṇibhyāṃ śiraḥ kaṇḍūyanaṃ striyaḥ |
kurvvantyo gurubharttṛṇāmājñāṃ bhetūsyantyanādṛtāḥ || 29 ||

items.text:
स्वपोषणपराः क्षुद्रा देहसंस्कारवर्ज्जिताः ।
परुषानृतभाषिण्यो भविष्यन्ति कलौ स्त्रियः ॥ ३० ॥
items.tr:
svapoṣaṇaparāḥ kṣudrā dehasaṃskāravarjjitāḥ |
paruṣānṛtabhāṣiṇyo bhaviṣyanti kalau striyaḥ || 30 ||

items.text:
दुः शीला दुष्टशीलेषु कुर्व्वन्त्यः सततं स्पृहाम् ।
असदूवुत्ता भविष्यन्ति पुरुषेषु कुलाङ्गनाः ॥ ३१ ॥
items.tr:
duḥ śīlā duṣṭaśīleṣu kurvvantyaḥ satataṃ spṛhām |
asadūvuttā bhaviṣyanti puruṣeṣu kulāṅganāḥ || 31 ||

items.text:
वेदादानं करिष्यन्ति वटवश्व तदाव्रताः ।
गुहस्थाश्व न होष्यन्ति न दास्यन्त्युचितान्यपि ॥ ३२ ॥
items.tr:
vedādānaṃ kariṣyanti vaṭavaśva tadāvratāḥ |
guhasthāśva na hoṣyanti na dāsyantyucitānyapi || 32 ||

items.text:
वनावासा भविष्यन्ति ग्राम्याहारपरिग्रहाः ।
भिक्षवश्वापि मित्रादिस्नेहसम्बन्धयन्त्रिताः ॥ ३३ ॥
items.tr:
vanāvāsā bhaviṣyanti grāmyāhāraparigrahāḥ |
bhikṣavaśvāpi mitrādisnehasambandhayantritāḥ || 33 ||

items.text:
अरक्षितारो हर्त्तारः शुल्कव्याजेन पार्थिवाः ।
हारिणो जनवित्तानां संप्राप्ते तु कलो युगे ॥ ३४ ॥
items.tr:
arakṣitāro harttāraḥ śulkavyājena pārthivāḥ |
hāriṇo janavittānāṃ saṃprāpte tu kalo yuge || 34 ||

items.text:
यो योऽश्वरथनागाढ्यः स स राजा भविष्यति ।
यश्व यश्वाबलः सर्व्वः स स भृत्यः कलौ युगे ॥ ३५ ॥
items.tr:
yo yo'śvarathanāgāḍhyaḥ sa sa rājā bhaviṣyati |
yaśva yaśvābalaḥ sarvvaḥ sa sa bhṛtyaḥ kalau yuge || 35 ||

items.text:
वैश्याः कृषिवाणिज्यादि सन्त्यज्य निजकर्म्म यत्
शूद्रवृत्त्या प्रवत्स्यन्ति कारुकर्म्मोपजीविनः ॥ ३६ ॥
items.tr:
vaiśyāḥ kṛṣivāṇijyādi santyajya nijakarmma yat
śūdravṛttyā pravatsyanti kārukarmmopajīvinaḥ || 36 ||

items.text:
भैक्ष्यव्रतास्तथा शूद्रा प्रब्रज्यालिङ्गिनोऽधमाः ।
पाषण्डसंश्रयाः वृत्तिमाश्रयिष्यन्त्यसंस्कृताः ॥ ३७ ॥
items.tr:
bhaikṣyavratāstathā śūdrā prabrajyāliṅgino'dhamāḥ |
pāṣaṇḍasaṃśrayāḥ vṛttimāśrayiṣyantyasaṃskṛtāḥ || 37 ||

items.text:
दुर्भिक्षकरपीड़ाबिरतीवोपहता जनाः ।
गवेधुककदन्नाद्यान् देशान् यास्यन्ति दुः खिताः ॥ ३८ ॥
items.tr:
durbhikṣakarapīṛābiratīvopahatā janāḥ |
gavedhukakadannādyān deśān yāsyanti duḥ khitāḥ || 38 ||

items.text:
वेदमार्गे प्रलीने च पाषण्डाढये ततो जने ।
अधर्म्मवृद्धया लोकानां स्वल्पमायुर्भविष्यति ॥ ३९ ॥
items.tr:
vedamārge pralīne ca pāṣaṇḍāḍhaye tato jane |
adharmmavṛddhayā lokānāṃ svalpamāyurbhaviṣyati || 39 ||

items.text:
अशास्त्रविहित्तं घोरं तप्यमानेषु वै तपः ।
नरेषु नृपदोषेण बालमृत्युर्भविष्यति ॥ ४० ॥
items.tr:
aśāstravihittaṃ ghoraṃ tapyamāneṣu vai tapaḥ |
nareṣu nṛpadoṣeṇa bālamṛtyurbhaviṣyati || 40 ||

items.text:
भवित्री योषितां सूतिः पञ्चषटूसप्तवार्षिकी ।
नवाष्टदशवर्षाणां मनुष्याणां तथा कलौ ॥ ४१ ॥
items.tr:
bhavitrī yoṣitāṃ sūtiḥ pañcaṣaṭūsaptavārṣikī |
navāṣṭadaśavarṣāṇāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ tathā kalau || 41 ||

items.text:
पतितोद्भवश्व भविता तदा द्रादशवार्षिकः ।
नातिजीवति वै कश्वित् कलौ वर्षाणि विंशतिम् ॥ ४२ ॥
items.tr:
patitodbhavaśva bhavitā tadā drādaśavārṣikaḥ |
nātijīvati vai kaśvit kalau varṣāṇi viṃśatim || 42 ||

items.text:
अल्पप्रज्ञा वृथालिङ्गा दुष्टान्तः करणाः कलौ ।
यतस्ततो विनङूक्ष्यन्ति कालेनाल्पेन मानवाः ॥ ४३ ॥
items.tr:
alpaprajñā vṛthāliṅgā duṣṭāntaḥ karaṇāḥ kalau |
yatastato vinaṅūkṣyanti kālenālpena mānavāḥ || 43 ||

items.text:
यदा यदा हि पाषणडवृद्धिर्मैत्रेय लक्ष्यते ।
तदा तदा कलेर्वृद्धिरनुमेया विचक्षणौः ॥ ४४ ॥
items.tr:
yadā yadā hi pāṣaṇaḍavṛddhirmaitreya lakṣyate |
tadā tadā kalervṛddhiranumeyā vicakṣaṇauḥ || 44 ||

items.text:
यदा यदा सतां हानिर्वेदमार्गानुसारिणाम् ।
प्रारम्भाश्वावसीदन्ति यदा धर्म्मभृतां नृणाम् ।
तदानुमेयं प्राधान्यं कलेर्मैत्रेय पणिडतैः ॥ ४५ ॥
items.tr:
yadā yadā satāṃ hānirvedamārgānusāriṇām |
prārambhāśvāvasīdanti yadā dharmmabhṛtāṃ nṛṇām |
tadānumeyaṃ prādhānyaṃ kalermaitreya paṇiḍataiḥ || 45 ||

items.text:
यदा यदा न यज्ञानामीश्वरः पुरुषोत्तमः ।
इज्यते पुरुषैर्यज्ञैस्तदा ज्ञे यं कलेर्बलम् ॥ ४६ ॥
items.tr:
yadā yadā na yajñānāmīśvaraḥ puruṣottamaḥ |
ijyate puruṣairyajñaistadā jñe yaṃ kalerbalam || 46 ||

items.text:
न प्रीतिर्वेदवादेषु पाषणडेषु यदा रतिः ।
कलेर्वृद्धिस्तदा प्राज्ञरैनुमेया विचक्षणैः ॥ ४७ ॥
items.tr:
na prītirvedavādeṣu pāṣaṇaḍeṣu yadā ratiḥ |
kalervṛddhistadā prājñarainumeyā vicakṣaṇaiḥ || 47 ||

items.text:
कलौ जगत्पतिं विष्णुं सर्व्वस्त्रष्टारमीश्वरम् ।
नार्च्चयिष्यन्ति मैत्रेय पाषणडोपहता नराः ॥ ४८ ॥
items.tr:
kalau jagatpatiṃ viṣṇuṃ sarvvastraṣṭāramīśvaram |
nārccayiṣyanti maitreya pāṣaṇaḍopahatā narāḥ || 48 ||

items.text:
कि वेदैः किं द्रिजैर्देवैः किं शौचेनाम्बुजन्मना ।
इत्येवं विप्र वक्ष्यन्ति पाषण्डोपहता नराः ॥ ४९ ॥
items.tr:
ki vedaiḥ kiṃ drijairdevaiḥ kiṃ śaucenāmbujanmanā |
ityevaṃ vipra vakṣyanti pāṣaṇḍopahatā narāḥ || 49 ||

items.text:
स्वल्पाम्बुवृष्टिः पर्ज्जन्यः शस्यं स्वल्पफल तथा
फलं तथाल्पसारञ्च विप्र प्रापते कलौ युगे ॥ ५० ॥
items.tr:
svalpāmbuvṛṣṭiḥ parjjanyaḥ śasyaṃ svalpaphala tathā
phalaṃ tathālpasārañca vipra prāpate kalau yuge || 50 ||

items.text:
शाणीप्रायाणि वस्त्राणि शमीप्राया महीरुहाः ।
शूद्रप्रायास्तथा वर्णा भविष्यन्ति कलौ युगे ॥ ५१ ॥
items.tr:
śāṇīprāyāṇi vastrāṇi śamīprāyā mahīruhāḥ |
śūdraprāyāstathā varṇā bhaviṣyanti kalau yuge || 51 ||

items.text:
अणुप्रायाणि धान्यानि अजाप्रायं तथा पयः ।
भविष्यति कलौ प्राप्ते उषोरञ्चानुलेपनम् ॥ ५२ ॥
items.tr:
aṇuprāyāṇi dhānyāni ajāprāyaṃ tathā payaḥ |
bhaviṣyati kalau prāpte uṣorañcānulepanam || 52 ||

items.text:
शश्रू-श्वशुरभूयिष्ठा गुरवश्व नृणां कलौ ।
श्यालाद्या हारिभाय्योश्व सुह्टदो मुनिसतम् ॥ ५३ ॥
items.tr:
śaśrū-śvaśurabhūyiṣṭhā guravaśva nṛṇāṃ kalau |
śyālādyā hāribhāyyośva suhṭado munisatam || 53 ||

items.text:
कस्य माता पिता कस्य यदा कर्म्मानुगः पुमान् ।
इति चोदाहरिष्यन्ति श्वशुरानुगेता नराः ॥ ५४ ॥
items.tr:
kasya mātā pitā kasya yadā karmmānugaḥ pumān |
iti codāhariṣyanti śvaśurānugetā narāḥ || 54 ||

items.text:
वाङूमनः कायिकैर्दोषैरभिभूताः पुनः पुनः ।
नराः पापान्यनुदिनं करिष्यन्त्यल्पमेधसः ॥ ५५ ॥
items.tr:
vāṅūmanaḥ kāyikairdoṣairabhibhūtāḥ punaḥ punaḥ |
narāḥ pāpānyanudinaṃ kariṣyantyalpamedhasaḥ || 55 ||

items.text:
निः सत्त्वानामशौचानां निः श्रीकाणां तथा नृणाम् ।
यदूयदू दुः शाय यत् सर्व्वं कलिकाले भविष्यति ॥ ५६ ॥
items.tr:
niḥ sattvānāmaśaucānāṃ niḥ śrīkāṇāṃ tathā nṛṇām |
yadūyadū duḥ śāya yat sarvvaṃ kalikāle bhaviṣyati || 56 ||

items.text:
निःस्वाध्यायवषटूकरि स्वधास्वाहाविवर्ज्जिते ।
तथा प्रविरलो विप्र क्वचिल्लोको निवत्स्यति ॥ ५७ ॥
items.tr:
niḥsvādhyāyavaṣaṭūkari svadhāsvāhāvivarjjite |
tathā praviralo vipra kvacilloko nivatsyati || 57 ||

items.text:
तत्राल्पेनैव यत्नेन पुण्यस्कन्धमनुत्तमम् ।
करोति यं कृतयुगे क्रियते तपसा हि सः ॥ ५८ ॥
items.tr:
tatrālpenaiva yatnena puṇyaskandhamanuttamam |
karoti yaṃ kṛtayuge kriyate tapasā hi saḥ || 58 ||

en_chapter: Maitreya said:—"Thou hast described unto me in detail, O illustrious sage, the creation of the universe, the genealogies of the Patriarchs, the duration of the Manwantaras and the dynasties of the princes. I am willing to hear from you an account of the dissolution of the universe, the time of total destruction and that which occurs at the expiration of a Kalpa".

Parāçara said:—Hear from me exactly, O Maitreya, the circumstances attending the dissolution of the world either at the expiration of a Kalpa or that which occurs at the close of the life of Brahmā. A month of men constitutes a day and night of the progenitors; a year of men is a day and night of the celestials. Twice a thousand aggregates of the four ages is a day and night of Brahmhā. The four ages are the Krita, Treta, Dwāpara and Kali, comprehending altogether twelve thousand years of the celestials. There are infinite successions of those four ages of a similar description, the first of which is always called Krita and the last the Kali. In the first, the Krita is that age which is created by Brahmā; in the last, which is the Kali age, a dissolution of the universe takes place.
Maitreya said:—"O venerable Sir, It behoves thee to give a description of the nature of the Kali age in which the four-footed virtue suffers total extinction".
Parāçara said:—Hear, O Maitreya, of the nature of the Kali age, regarding which you have enquired and which is now approaching completion.

In the Kali age, people will not serve caste, order and institutes, nor the ceremonial enjoined by the Sāma, Rik and Yayur Vedas. Marriages in this age will be celebrated according to the rituals, nor will the rules that connect the spiritual protector and his disciple be in force; the laws that regulate the conduct of husband and wife will be neglected and oblations to the celestials with fire no longer be offered. A powerful and rich man, in whatever family he may be born, will have right to marry maidens of every tribe. In the Kali age, a Brāhmana will be always regarded as such even if he be not initiated properly, and many forms of penance will be prescribed. O Maitreya, O twice-born one, all texts will be considered as Sastras in the Kali age; all celestials will be considered in equal light and all orders of life will be common alike to all persons. In this Kali age, fasting, austerity, liberality practised according to the pleasures of those by whom they are observed will constitute piety. Every trifling property will make men proud of their wealth. Pride of beauty will be inspired by hair. Gold, jewels, diamonds, clothes will all have perished, and then hair will be the only ornament with which women can decorate themselves. Wives will desert their husbands when they will lose their wealth; and the rich only will be considered by woman as their lords. He who will distribute immense wealth, will be considered as master of men and prestige of birth will no longer be a title to supremacy. Accumulated wealth will be spent on ostentatious dwellings. The minds of men will be wholly occupied with earning money and that even will be spent on the gratification of selfish desires. Women will follow their own inclinations and be given up to pleasure-seeking. Men will endeavour to acquire riches even dishonestly. No man will part with the smallest fraction of his wealth at the sacrifice of his own interest even when requested by his friends. In the Kali age all people will consider themselves as equal with the Brāhmanas; and cows will be held in reverence only because they supply milk. People will be always in fear of dearth and scarcity and will watch accordingly the appearances of the sky. They will all live, like anchorets, upon leaves and roots and fruits and put a period to their lives through fear of famine and want. Deprived of wealth, people will be perpetually subject to famine and other afflictions; and they will never enjoy pleasure and happiness. At the advent of the Kali they will take their food without previous ablutions and without worshipping fire, celestials or guests or offering obsequial libations to their progenitors. The women will be fickle, short of stature, gluttonous; they will all have many children and little means. And scratching their heads with both hands they will pay no attention to the commands of their husbands or parents. They will be selfish, abject and slovenly; they will be scolds and liars; they will be indecent and immoral in their conduct and will ever attach themselves to dissolute men. And disregarding the rules of studentship youths will study the Vedas. Householders will neither sacrifice nor practise becoming liberality. Anchorets will live upon food accepted from rustics and mendicants will be influenced by regard for friends and associates. Princes will plunder their subjects instead of protecting them and under the pretext of levying customs they will rob merchants of their property. In the Kali Vuga every one, possessing cars and elephants and horses, will be a Raja; every one who is feeble will be a slave. Vaiçyas will abandon agriculture and commerce and gain a livelihood by servitude or exercise of mechanical arts; Sudras, seeking a subsistence by begging and assuming outward marks of religious mendicants, will become the impure followers of impious and heretical doctrines.

Oppressed by famine and taxation men will desert their native countries and repair to the lands which are fit for coarser grains. The path of the Vedas being obliterated and people having deviated into heresy, iniquity will flourish and the duration of life will therefore decrease. On account of the horrible penances enjoined by scripture and of the vices of the rulers, children will die in their infancy. Women will bear children at the age of five, six or seven years and men will beget them when they are eight, nine or ten. Men will grow old at the age of twelve and no one will live more than twenty years. Men will possess little sense, vigour virtue and will therefore die in a short time. O Maitreya, the wise then estimate the approach of Kali when the number of heretics increases. Whenever, O Maitreya, number of the pious devoted to the lessons of the Vedas, diminishes, the efforts, of the individuals who cultivate virtue, become relax; the first of males becomes no longer the object of sacrifice; respect for the teachers of the Vedas declines and regard is cherished for the disseminators of heresy, the wise estimate the augmented influence of the Kali.

O Maitreya, in the Kali age corrupted by unbelievers, men will refrain from adoring Vishnu, the lord of sacrifice and the creator and sovereign of all and will say "Of what authority are the Vedas? What are the celestials or Brahmanas? What need there is of purification with water?" At the approach of the Kali, O Vipra, the clouds will yield scanty rain; the corn will be light in ear and the grain will be poor and of little sap: garments will be mostly made of the fibres of the San: the principal of trees will be the Sami; principle caste will be the Sudra; millet will be the more common grain; the milk in use will be chiefly that of goats; unguents will be made of Ushira grass. The mother and father-in-law will be venerated in the place of parents; and a man's friend will be his brother-in-law or one who has a wanton wife. Men will say "Who has a father? Who has a mother? Every one is born according to his deeds"; therefore they will regard the wife's or the husband's parents as their own. Gifted with little sense they will be subject to all sorts of infirmities of mind, speech and body and will daily commit sins; and every thing that is likely to afflict beings, vicious, impure and wretched will be generated in the Kali Yuga. Thus, O Brahman, when holy study, oblations to fire and convocations of the celestials shall be stopped some few people shall live at a holy place. And at this place with the least trouble that piety shall be accumulated which could be acquired with the greatest exertions in the Krita age.
